anya (Product): Quick heads-up: BeaconCorp wants a pilot next week. Requirements: private deploy, customer-managed keys (BYOK), per-tenant KV cache, and 100ms P95 for gen. Can we scope an MVP?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Short answer: doable if we accept tradeoffs. HSM calls add latency; BYOK avoids HSM but needs envelope encryption. Per-tenant cache doable but RAM multiplies. Need to pick a model/quant level to hit 100ms.

mike (Infra): For private infra to reach 100ms P95 we need reserved GPUs and prewarm. Standard provisioning = ~10bd. With exec sign-off we can push to ~5bd. Also need network egress rules for customer KMS.

lina (Security): HSM integration + attestation + policy review = ~3w. BYOK pilot possible under temporary exception but we need audit logging, key rotation windows, and legal sign-off. I can draft exception + checklist in 48h.

carol (Eng-SRE): Observability needs: per-tenant latency dashboard, token-level cost, and an alert at 120ms. Recommend canary traffic limited to BeaconCorp + synthetic spike tests. Also add an automated fallback to hosted model on degradation.

anya (Product): Two options:
- Option Fast: BYOK only, per-tenant cache, scoped pilot. ETA ~7bd.
- Option Secure: full HSM route, attestation, ETA ~4w.
Which path?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Option Fast: I can add runtime flag for BYOK + envelope encryption and a graceful fallback to hosted in ~72h with one engineer. Example runtime config we could use:
```yaml
route: /v1/pilot/beacon-gen
model: redwood/opt-7b-q4
kms_mode: customer_byok
cache: per_tenant
fallback: hosted-opt-7b
```

mike (Infra): If PM approves Option Fast we can provision reserved nodes + networking in 5bd. With exec sign-off can do 3bd. Option Secure adds procurement + HSM certs -> ~3w.

lina (Security): I'll prepare the exception template outlining required audit fields (envelope keys, access logs, rotation cadence). Need legal to sign the pilot terms; I'll loop them in. Draft in 48h.

carol (Eng-SRE): I'll build the canary runbook and dashboards. Will set alerts at 120ms and implement automated fallback to hosted model. Canary will limit traffic to BeaconCorp and run synthetic bursts. ETA: Thursday.

anya (Product): Proposed decision: go with Option Fast (BYOK + per-tenant KV cache + target 100ms P95) as a pilot. Owners: sam -> runtime feature & fallback; mike -> infra provisioning; lina -> security exception & audit; carol -> canary + observability. Everyone ack + ETA?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Ack. 72h for feature flag + basic tests.

mike (Infra): Ack. 5bd for reserved infra; 3bd with exec sign-off.

lina (Security): Ack. Exception draft in 48h, then legal review.

carol (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook and dashboards by Thursday, will add rollback steps.

ops-bot: Created ticket BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT: https://tickets/BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT — please update timelines in ticket.

anya (Product): Thanks team. Ill confirm scope with BeaconCorp: "BYOK KMS + per-tenant cache + 100ms P95 target; traffic scoped to BeaconCorp pilot." Weekly check-ins M/W. Reopen thread for blockers. :v:
